verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is an agent knowledge and memory layer, so published recall benchmarks are a fair question for it. The evidence pack only describes scopes, pages, links, permissions and Studio views. It contains no LongMemEval, LoCoMo or other memory-quality benchmark results, and no recall-accuracy claims backed by measurements.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims
